publicationRepair.cause: Recovery fixtures have a synthetic checkout without a Git HEAD. Native guard preparation refuses it before dispatch.
publicationRepair.change: Supply the deterministic checkout HEAD at the native Git boundary; assert no preparation while held and durable starting-head proof at dispatch. Production code is unchanged.
